subject: Request: price safety-net for variable-usage 5yr agreement — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medisys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@medisys.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing request — safety net for variable usage / 5yr term

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. We're close on scope but need one non-standard commercial ask from our finance team before we can commit to a 5-year SOW.

Summary of the ask:
- Because our product adoption will ramp and usage is variable, Medisys needs a price safety-net that prevents step-ups above a defined annual uplift cap (we proposed 6% in our internal model).
- If usage grows beyond the forecast, Medisys wants a cap on year-over-year price increases (we'd accept a floor tied to cost if needed).
- They also want a renewal protection clause that preserves the effective unit price for the first 3 renewals unless both parties agree to material changes.

I've attached the latest SOW (Medisys_SOW_v3.pdf) and a usage_simulation.xlsx that shows our forecasted token usage vs their projected heavy-adoption scenarios. We view this as a commercial exception and so asked our procurement lead to route for your approval.

Can Redwood provide an executive decision on whether we can:
1) Cap annual uplifts at 6% for years 1-5, with a not-to-exceed 12% aggregate uplift over the 5 years; and
2) Add a renewal protection clause that guarantees the effective per-unit price for renewals unless both parties materially change the scope?

Timetable: Medisys is asking for a signed SOW by EOD Friday (11th). They're willing to accept a short-term escrow arrangement for over-usage mitigation if we require it.

Happy to jump on a quick call with anyone on your side to walk through the scenarios.

Best,
Oliver
Director of Procurement | Medisys Health
O: 415-555-0122

Attachments: Medisys_SOW_v3.pdf, usage_simulation.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing request — safety net for variable usage / 5yr term (exec approval request)

Marissa / Jordan — forwarding Medisys' ask. This is outside standard deal desk guardrails because they want both a multi-year price protection and a hard uplift cap tied to variable usage.

Quick summary and my recommended commercial guardrails:
- Proposed concession: cap annual uplift at 6% for each year, with a maximum cumulative uplift of 12% over the full 5-year term.
- Mitigant: require a Minimum Annual Commitment (MAC) for years 1-2 (they agreed to a 15% uplift to MRR in the model), and include a quarterly usage true-up (billing following a usage reconciliation).
- Optional: escrow or credited token bucket to cover overage surges in year 1 only.

Why I'm ok to escalate: this helps close a strategic health-care customer and protects Redwood from unbounded upside erosion while meeting their procurement requirement. But this is a non-standard term and needs exec authorization for the 5-year duration and the uplift cap numbers.

Attachments: usage_simulation.xlsx (analysis tab with three scenarios).

Asks:
- Marissa: pricing sign-off + confirm whether we can accept the 6% annual cap / 12% aggregate.
- Jordan: ops readiness — can you quantify monitoring / billing changes and confirm we can add a quarterly reconciliation step to the SOW?
- Kimberly (legal): flag any language issues for the renewal protection clause.

If we approve, we need wording for the SOW and a DocuSign-ready SOW by Thursday COB to meet Medisys' timeline.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Mina — good write-up. I reviewed the usage_simulation.xlsx and the commercial impact. Approve subject to the conditions below.

Decision (high level): APPROVE the uplift cap request with constraints.

Required conditions before signing:
- Legal to add explicit renewal protection language: "Effective unit pricing for renewals shall remain at the lesser of (a) the prior term effective unit price, or (b) the then-applicable list price less any applicable discounts, provided no material scope changes have been agreed." Kimberly, please confirm wording or propose edits.
- Approve annual uplift cap at 6% per year, with a cumulative cap of 12% across the 5-year term. This reduces downside for Medisys while limiting Redwood exposure.
- Include a Minimum Annual Commitment for years 1-2 (15% uplift to initial MRR) and a quarterly usage reconciliation. Failure to meet MAC results in billing true-ups or reversion to list price.
- Finance to approve estimated unit-economics impact (I've flagged Finance for a quick run but we should be within our tolerance if MAC is included).

Commercial redlines: we should not accept an unconditional price floor; instead tie it to our costs and cost-pass-through for material infra price increases.

Action owner list:
- Kimberly: finalize renewal protection clause and confirm no legal risk.
- Jordan: confirm operational feasibility for quarterly reconciliations and billing flows.
- Mina: if Kim & Jordan confirm, proceed to update the SOW and prepare DocuSign.

I will provide executive sign-off once both legal and ops confirm and finance gives a quick thumbs-up.

Marissa
VP, Global Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
